queries: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), t AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - t.overall AS difference FROM g CROSS JOIN t ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A large order is one with amount strictly greater than 2802; an amount of exactly 2802 is not counted as large.
The overall figure is the unweighted mean of the per-(account, region) averages, not the mean over individual orders, as the request states.
Inner joins from order to account to district drop orders without a matching account or district, as the request states.

alternatives.interpretation: A large order is one with amount at or above the cutoff (amount >= 2802).
